results.name: Frozen source yields four complete task candidate routes and a short local-feedback route, without inventing audio or calibration
Task1 table and Task2 prompt preserve original data while author answers and world policy writes remain excluded
Strict calibration protocol rejects duplicate fields, self-approved claims, overall section and changed target
Default calibration inspector accepts no model, fixture or hash-integrity self-signature as a human decision
Material, question, support, audio, order, tool and evaluator changes invalidate only exact bound calibration records
Two editor roles require two actual authorities; a script hash never supplies final full audio audition
Pilot statistics aggregate by participant and keep unanswered items visible; correlated retries do not inflate subjects
Relevant section verification, consent, exposure and declared support prevent misleading pooled pilot results
Complete writing needs two distinct trained blind human raters; short text and simulated raters never produce a full band
Predeclared disagreement tolerance requires third review, and revised response or evaluator invalidates the old rater pair
Observation revision replaces one interpretation, never another attempt; export contains hashes and excludes erased epochs
Unverified natural language candidates remain unassessed and cannot alter review success or failure schedules
